model.contract: The selected provider/model and session display name are observable through RPC get_state.

toolAllowlist.result: tool error: Tool write not found

systemPrompt.contract: Explicit system prompt replaces the default prompt; appended text is separated by blank lines; Pi still appends its cwd context.

filesystem.observed: A relative ../outside-sentinel.txt write succeeded from the isolated project.
filesystem.contract: Pi does not sandbox filesystem paths. The caller must provide a constrained cwd, tool allowlist, and any OS-level sandboxing.

approval.observed: --approve and --no-approve control project-local resource trust only. No native per-tool approval event or prompt was observed in JSON/RPC runs.
approval.contract: A host integration must implement any human approval policy outside Pi or expose only pre-approved tools.

budget.observed: Usage and cost are emitted on assistant messages, turns, and session records, but the CLI has no total token/cost budget flag.
budget.contract: A host integration must enforce budget limits from usage events and terminate/abort explicitly.
